Latest news from our research Research from Runway November 11, 2026 Praxis-1: From Video Pretraining to Robot Control by Runway With Praxis-1, we turn a 27B-parameter video foundation model into an open weight world model that predicts the future in short chunks. A small action expert reads the video model’s internal state as it imagines what comes next. Each time the robot acts, Praxis-1 predicts both what the scene will look like and the motion that will get it there. Praxis-1 fine-tuned on DROID is the top world action model and the top open-source robot foundation model on the RoboLab-120 leaderboard. On a real Franka arm it achieves a competitive success rate against the previous state-of-the-art world action model.... Read Paper September 3, 2026 GWM Worlds 2 by Runway GWM Worlds 2 turns high-fidelity video and audio generation into real-time interactive simulation. You define a world — its environment, subjects, visual style, physical rules and ambience — then steer it with free-form text actions and continuous camera motion, generating continuous 720p video at 24 fps and audio at 48,000 Hz that responds to your inputs as you explore. A research preview extending GWM Worlds with generated audio and rich subject and scene control.... Read Paper September 1, 2026 Solaris: Towards Interfaces That Are Generated, Not Coded by Yuval Alaluf, Omri Avrahami, Anastasis Germanidis, Michal Geyer, Kfir Goldberg, Guy Bukchin Leshem, Alejandro Matamala Ortiz, Elad Richardson + 13 authors Digital interfaces are traditionally implemented through intermediate representations such as code, requiring their appearance and behavior to be specified in advance. We introduce Solaris, an interface world model that instead generates an interactive UI directly, frame by frame, in response to user actions. Solaris treats mouse interactions as conditioning signals and autoregressively synthesizes the resulting visual state at interactive speeds. To enable real-time generation while maintaining visual coherence over extended interactions, we combine autoregressive frame generation with few-step distillation and training on the model s own outputs....
